sysd-q-069.caption: A message waits in the station and is retried until the destination can be reached.
sysd-q-069.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Sender] --> B[Station stores message]
B --> C[Check integrity]
C --> D{Reachable now?}
D -->|yes| E[Send at once]
D -->|no| F[Keep it and retry later]
F -.-> D

sysd-q-002.caption: Follow one message from the sender's chat service to an online or an offline recipient.
sysd-q-002.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Sender's chat service] --> B[Sequencing service adds ID]
B --> C[Persist, queue for sync]
C --> D{Recipient online?}
D -->|yes| E[Push over web socket]
D -->|no| F[Queue push event]
F --> G[Notification service]
G --> H[FCM or APNS]

sysd-q-021.caption: Push and pull trade writes against reads, and the hybrid splits users by follower count.
rows: Immediately, when a tweet is posted
Push for few followers, pull for many

sysd-q-023.caption: The five stages run in order, and the first big cut is from 500 million tweets to 1500 candidates.
sysd-q-023.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Candidate sourcing: 500 million tweets] --> B[Global filtering: 1500 candidates]
B --> C[Scoring and ranking]
C --> D[Filtering for diversity]
D --> E[Mixing with ads and Who to Follow]

sysd-q-035.caption: An upload passes through a queue, a chunker, a filter and a transcoder before the CDN serves it.
sysd-q-035.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Content team uploads video] --> B[Message queue]
B --> C[File chunker splits by scene]
C --> D[Content filter]
D -->|problems| E[Dead-letter queue]
D --> F[Transcoder]
F --> G[(HDFS or object store)]
G --> H[CDN]
H --> I[Viewers]

sysd-q-016.caption: The ride service looks up nearby drivers in a location index, then broadcasts the request.
sysd-q-016.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Customer requests ride] --> B[Ride service finds nearby drivers]
B --> G[(Geohash and quadtree index)]
B --> C[Broadcasts request]
C --> D[Driver accepts]
D --> E[Customer sees live location]

sysd-q-048.caption: The Crawler Service skips a link whose page looks like one it has already stored, which prevents a cycle.
sysd-q-048.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[(links_to_crawl)] --> B[Crawler Service takes top link]
B --> C{Similar signature?}
C -->|yes| D[Lower link priority]
D -.-> A
C -->|no| E[Crawl the link]
E --> F[Reverse Index job]
E --> G[Document Service job]
E --> H[(crawled_links)]

sysd-q-056.caption: The three processes run in order: crawl, index, then serve ranked results.
sysd-q-056.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Crawl: follow links from seeds] --> B[Index: analyze and organize]
B --> C[Serve: analyze the query]
C --> D[Retrieve from the index]
D --> E[Rank by relevance]

sysd-q-054.caption: Proposed waits between requests to one site range from 60 seconds down to 1 second.
